entry.name: triage-bug
entry.description: Interactive bug-triage → investigation workflow as a pi prompt template. Invoke as `/triage-bug <TICKET-KEY>`. Asks before any Jira write. Enforces strict triage→investigate handoff via triage-context.json. Headless counterpart lives at my-engineering-library/workflows/bug-triage/.

requires.name: atlassian-toolkit
requires.description: Self-contained CLI toolkit for Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence) via API token — no MCP, no npm install (Node >= 20). Shared dependency for agentic workflows using Atlassian tools. Infrastructure, not a task the model performs directly. One-time setup via 'jira.mjs config init' (~/.config/atlassian-toolkit/config.json; env vars override) — see the skill's README; verify with bin/smoke.mjs.

requires.name: bug-investigator
requires.description: Investigate sparse Jira bug tickets and enrich them with a grounded root-cause theory. Fetch the ticket, trace code across repos (starting from any linked PRs the triager found), form a falsifiable theory, and append to Dev Notes or return a draft. Triggers on "investigate this", "look at this bug", "trace down this bug", or pasting a Jira bug key/URL.

requires.name: bug-triager
requires.description: Triage a Jira bug by searching Jira for related, duplicate, or previously-fixed tickets before code investigation. Ranks matches, captures their linked pull requests, optionally posts a related-tickets comment, and hands off to bug-investigator. Triggers on "triage this", "has this been reported", "find related tickets", "check for duplicates".
